expectation: Bulk development process lifecycle actions keep the hibernation marker aligned with the process group state.

protection.reference: apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Services/Processes/RuntimeHibernationTest.php: marks a development app instance asleep before a bulk process stop
protection.rejected_example: A bulk development process stop leaves the scope awake, so Caddy bypasses activation and returns HTTP 502.
protection.accepted_example: A bulk development process stop marks the scope asleep before stopping its process group, so the next request activates it.
